advanced.vacuumDesc: Reclaim disk space used by deleted books (VACUUM)
advanced.concurrencyDesc: How many feeds to refresh at the same time at most

ai.ragLimitDesc: How many relevant passages the Q&A retrieves for a question.

ai.apiTypeDesc: The request format used to call it — needn't match the vendor name. Pick Custom for any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
